title: Client page view
description: Everything the backend recorded for one page view of a browser: the traces of its requests and the log lines they and its own client events wrote. The client trace id is a correlation id the browser mints for a page load, never a parent; each request is a trace of its own.

list.name: client_trace_id
list.label: Client trace id
list.description: 32 lower-case hex digits: the trace id of a traceparent a browser sent, as recorded in client_trace_id on a log line or client.trace_id on a request span. The default is not a valid id, so it matches nothing.

panels.title: Backend traces of this page view
panels.description: One row per backend trace whose request span carries this client trace id: one per API request the page made, each a trace of its own. Open a row to see the trace.

panels.title: Log lines of this page view
panels.description: The backend's log lines for the requests of this page view and for the client events the page reported. Each request line carries the trace_id of its own backend trace.
